note: Set 2, frozen after the hackathon deadline of 2026-11-14 23:59 UTC and before the first scored week began on 2026-11-16.
rule_for_part1: If P9, P10 and P11 all miss, the claim that Intents is still gaining ground is rejected.
rule_for_part2: If P12 misses, NEAR is no longer priced far above router tokens on revenue and part 2 weakens.

predictions.metric: mean weekly NEAR Intents volume, weeks ending 2026-11-22 to 2027-01-10
predictions.rule: at least 1.1x the mean of the last 4 weeks at freeze

predictions.claim: Intents sets a new share high
predictions.metric: mean weekly Intents share of all DEX volume, weeks ending 2026-11-22 to 2027-01-10
predictions.rule: at least the mean of the latest 13 weeks at freeze

predictions.claim: Intents carries half of all router volume
predictions.metric: Intents share of the combined volume of the 5 routers in data/peers, 2026-11-16 to 2027-01-10
predictions.rule: at least 50% (47.7% in the 91 days to freeze)

predictions.claim: NEAR stays far pricier per revenue dollar than router tokens
predictions.metric: NEAR market cap over annualised Intents revenue, divided by the median of the same ratio for routers with a token, 2026-11-16 to 2027-01-10
predictions.rule: at least 5x (15.1x in the 91 days to freeze)

predictions.claim: The base chain does not recover
predictions.metric: mean NearBlocks daily active accounts, weeks ending 2026-11-22 to 2027-01-10
predictions.rule: below 1.4x the mean of the latest 13 weeks at freeze
at least 25%, above the last 13 weeks at freeze (18.7%)
